info.title: pruna/p-video-2-pro-avatar
info.description: The request body Comfy Router accepts for the model "pruna/p-video-2-pro-avatar", and the response body it returns. The INPUT schema is the same schema the server validates a call against before it reaches the provider, so what is published and what is enforced cannot differ. `x-comfy-router-input-modalities` records the media kinds the model is documented to accept; the request schema is shared across sibling models and may admit media kinds this model ignores. The OUTPUT schema describes the provider's native result document exactly as Router returns it: Router does not validate, narrow or re-envelope the response, so the output schema is descriptive rather than enforced, and Comfy owns no output shape of its own.

post.summary: Queued-only: this route answers 403 not_enabled for pruna/p-video-2-pro-avatar; use POST /v2/models/pruna/p-video-2-pro-avatar/requests.

schema.description: Request body for `POST /proxy/pruna/v1/predictions/p-video-2-pro-avatar`. The model is fixed by the route, so the body carries only Pruna's `input` object.

200.description: OK - the model's native JSON output, returned unchanged; the schema describes the provider's terminal result document as Router returns it.

schema.description:
Comfy Router output schema for `pruna/p-video-2`, `pruna/p-video-2-pro-avatar` and `pruna/p-video-2-pro-reference`: the terminal `GET /proxy/pruna/v1/predictions/status/{id}` document, forwarded unchanged. The operation is SUBMIT-AND-POLL and Router polls on the caller's behalf, so the body a caller receives is the finished prediction (`status: succeeded`) rather than the handle the submit returns.
The generated video is at `generation_url`. A failed prediction carries `error` instead (and `moderation` when Pruna's safety checker blocked it), and a canceled one carries only `status` and `message`.

PrunaPVideo2ProAvatarInput.description: P-Video-2-Pro Avatar parameters. The job is billed per second of the returned video, measured from the returned file and rounded down to a whole second, at the rate for `resolution`. The safety filter is always on; an `enable_safety_filter` value in the request is ignored.

audio.description: Speech audio URI, 1 second to 3 minutes, at most 64 MiB. It sets the output length. When set, `voice_script` is ignored.

image.description: Portrait URI, used as the first frame. jpg, png or webp, at most 20 MiB. It sets the aspect ratio.

prompt_upsampling.description: Adds the scene's motion from the portrait to `prompt`.

resolution.description: Output resolution: 480p, 768p, 1080p, 2k or 4k. 1080p, 2k and 4k upscale the 768p video.

voice_prompt.description: Delivery instructions for `voice_script` (tone, pacing, accent). Not spoken.

voice_script.description: Words to speak with text-to-speech when `audio` is not set.

PrunaPredictionModeration.description: Pruna's safety-checker verdict. Present on a failed status when content moderation blocked the prediction.

blocked.description: Whether the safety checker blocked the prediction.

can_disable.description: Whether the block comes from a safety filter the request could disable.

categories.description: Content-policy categories that triggered the block, for example sexual.

phase.description: What was screened: input (the submitted request) or output (the generated video).

error.description: Error message. Present when status is failed.

generation_url.description: URL of the finished video. Present when status is succeeded.

status.description: Prediction status: starting, processing, succeeded, failed or canceled.
